title: setup commits an absolute relay path into settings.json
what: setup writes no machine path into a committed file (the marketplace path goes to the local settings or is derived from $RELAY_HOME), and the Done list names every permission and setting it added.
why: Found 30 Oct by the trial of relay on a copy of relay cleaned of relay (owner, 30 Oct: "Полагаю что для текущих задач будет не лишним проверить подключение relay к самому relay, очищенному от relay"); sandbox HOME, RELAY_HOME and RELAY_PROJECTS, claude stubbed. setup wrote the shared .claude/settings.json with extraKnownMarketplaces pointing at the absolute path /Users/amidman/relay, 'openspec@amidman': false, and permissions allow Bash(kit:*), Bash(bin/kit:*), Bash(relay:*); the file is committed for the whole team, the path is this Mac's, and setup's Done list mentions none of it.
failing_case: `relay setup` in a fresh repo: .claude/settings.json contains '/Users/amidman/relay' and three Bash permissions; the Done list names none.
pass_cases: the committed settings.json holds no absolute path
the Done list names each permission added
a project with its own settings.json keeps its entries
